answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a refundable stake that grows with the number of identities sharing a funding source, a "vine" of linked wallets. Stake per identity is S times k squared, where k is the cluster size found by tracing deposits. A bridge between clusters needs an established voucher who risks slashing. At the zenith of reputation, rewards are capped per cluster, so 100 fakes cost 10,000 S, yet earn one agent's share.
